requirements.statement: ZeroAI is the deterministic authority around models; model output is advisory until accepted by deterministic controls.
AgentPhone is the exclusive telephony provider. Twilio is prohibited in runtime code and dependencies.
AgentMail is the exclusive application email provider unless this requirement is explicitly superseded.
Application database access uses Neon Data API only; direct Postgres drivers and ORM database connections are prohibited.
ZeroMemory stores compact durable state outside model context and preserves provenance/conflict state.
Every engineering change declares expected paths, protected paths, invariants and acceptance criteria before implementation.
No evidence means UNKNOWN. A model or executor cannot certify its own success.
Only a GitHub merge to main may initiate production deployment; agents do not directly deploy.
Every user prompt enters ZeroAI through ZeroIntercept before any provider receives it.
ZeroAI determines and authorizes the repository, memory, policy, and workspace context disclosed to a model.
Models may propose structured actions but cannot execute operating-system, Git, database, network, browser, deployment, or external-tool actions directly.
All mutating coding work executes in an isolated Git worktree or equivalent shadow state; the user's active checkout remains untouched until certification succeeds.
Every proposed action is evaluated by deterministic execution authority against explicit capabilities and active policy before execution.
Execution evidence is derived from deterministic tool outputs, hashes, exit codes, and system assertions; sensitive traces follow retention policy.
Only certified results may become trusted repository state or update ZeroMemory; state commit detects base-SHA conflicts before applying.
The primary developer entrypoint is an interactive ZeroAI CLI session launched from a repository with the zeroai command.
ZeroAI supports user-selected AI providers through BYOK/provider adapters while ZeroAI retains control-plane authority.

The first runtime acceptance path is zeroai -> natural-language bug request -> intercept -> context -> provider -> authorized isolated execution -> deterministic certification -> atomic state commit -> memory update -> evidenced result.
